summary: Verified (A) 'Use my location' chip in TopNav country switcher and (B) India NCR pincode allowlist (201301-201318). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — GET /api/config/countries returns exactly [CI, IN] with LR filtered out; serviceability returns serviceable=true with match='pincode_allowlist' for 201301/201305/201310/201318; Bangalore 560001 returns serviceable=false; IN without postal_code falls back to hub check (serviceable=false, no IN hubs seeded); CI Cocody still hub-based serviceable=true with nearest_hub 'MARTbakēd Cocody' (~0.87 km). DB check: LR row preserved (active=t, production_visible=f). Admin /suppliers?country=LR did not 500 (returned normally after admin login). Frontend: country popover shows exactly 2 rows (Côte d'Ivoire + India) — no Liberia. data-testid='country-detect-chip' visible with text 'Use my location' + MapPin icon. Denied path (no geolocation permission granted) produced the exact expected toast copy: 'Location permission is blocked. Enable it in your browser settings, then try again.' Country did NOT change from CI. Grant path (granted geolocation + set_geolocation Delhi coords) produced NO toast and country stayed CI — treated as SKIP per review-request instructions: Google Maps JS API reverse-geocode is not loaded in headless preview env, so detectCountryByLocation likely returned reason='no_maps' silently or the call never completed. Per spec this is environmental, not a code bug.
critical_code_review_comments: IN_PINCODE_ALLOWLIST correctly built as {'201301'..'201318'} using range(201301, 201319). Bypass short-circuits BEFORE the country/hub query — good ordering.
config_svc/routes.py now correctly filters countries.production_visible=True globally (APP_ENV bypass removed). LR row preserved at DB layer as expected.
TopNav DETECT_REASON_COPY dict exactly matches the copy strings enumerated in the review request — denied variant verified live.
Grant-path variant is untestable in headless (Google Maps JS API not present); recommend adding a unit test that mocks window.google.maps.Geocoder rather than relying on live headless geo permission.
